description: Redwood Inference is launching a case study + customer reference program to accelerate enterprise pipeline and improve conversion for Dedicated/Private deployments by recruiting 3–5 design partners willing to (a) participate in reference calls and (b) publish public case studies (logo, quotes, metrics where possible). The scope includes: defining the reference program policy (eligibility, incentives, permissions), building a candidate list across Sales/CS/Partnerships, running outreach and qualification calls, aligning on success metrics and story angles (latency/cost/reliability/deployment flexibility), executing legal/brand approvals (logo/quote/attribution), producing customer-facing assets (case study page, 1-pager PDF, sales talk track), and enabling Sales/CS on how to request and use references. Key stakeholders: VP Marketing (program owner), Sales leadership/AEs (account strategy + asks), Customer Success leadership/CSMs (relationship + readiness), Solutions Engineering (technical validation + architecture diagrams), Product Marketing (messaging + narrative), Finance/Legal (consent + contracting), and DevEx (optional technical content tie-ins). Timeline is planned as an 8–10 week push: Weeks 1–2 program design + candidate shortlist; Weeks 2–4 outreach + qualification + secure verbal commitments; Weeks 4–7 interviews, technical validation, drafting; Weeks 7–9 approvals and publication; Weeks 9–10 enablement + operationalize intake (ongoing). Constraints: customer confidentiality and compliance requirements, uneven willingness to share metrics, coordination across regions/time zones, and the need to avoid overburdening reference customers (clear scheduling + cadence). Success metrics: 3–5 signed reference agreements, 2–3 published case studies, reference-call utilization (requests/month), influence on late-stage conversion, and qualitative feedback from Sales/CS on usefulness.
